What's new
DeepSeek-V4.1 gets up to 2.3x more throughput per GPU on H200, and now runs on AMD MI350X / MI355X with up to 1.9x throughput from DSpark (#41251, #41308).
Qwen3.8-Flash-Next decodes 12% faster on B200, and GLM-5.3-Flash with DFlash 10% faster on B300 (#42175, #42489).
MiMo-V2.6-Pro gets 1.85x decode throughput with DFlash on B300 (#41886).
Models load 10x faster with the new InstantTensor loader (#40453).
PD disaggregation gets up to 27% more throughput and half the p95 TTFT on long-prompt workloads (#40703).
HiSparse now supports EAGLE and MTP for long-context serving with the KV cache in CPU memory (#37771).
GLM-5.2 and GLM-5.3 can now combine decode context parallelism with MTP, with up to 2.1x faster decoding on GLM-5.3 (#43735).
SGLang now runs on Apple Silicon Macs with the standard PyTorch backend, alongside MLX (#36780).
MiniMax-H3 and Qwen-Image 2.1 now run in ComfyUI with SGLang Diffusion, which also loads community GGUF checkpoints and LoRAs (#43504, #43581, #42556, #39523, #42174).
Important fix: Hybrid linear models could resume from wrong mamba states when speculative decoding and structured output were used together. Thanks to @Wirick and Baseten for finding it (#43029).
To upgrade
SGLang now requires Python 3.11 or newer.
uv pip install --prerelease=allow sglang==0.5.22

Breaking Changes & Upgrade Notes
SGLang requires Python 3.11 or newer. On Python 3.10, pip install sglang does not fail; it resolves to the last release that supported 3.10. Move to Python 3.11+ (for example off the Ubuntu 22.04 system Python) to get this and later releases: #43021
--enable-dp-attention is deprecated; use --attn-dp-size N. --dp-size now counts model replicas only. The old --dp-size N --enable-dp-attention still resolves to --attn-dp-size N with a warning; combining replicas with attention DP, or passing both spellings, is rejected at startup: #41818. Under DeepSeek context parallelism, --dp-size N still means attention DP but now warns and will be rejected after 2026-12-31: #42348
--disaggregation-decode-host-receive-threshold flips its encoding. 1 (the new default) disables host receive and 0 now means always receive on host. Configurations that passed 0 to disable it must pass 1: #43407
ChunkCache is removed. With --disable-radix-cache, full-attention, hybrid-SWA and Mamba models run UnifiedRadixCache in disabled mode and pure-SWA models run PureSWARadixCache (#43198, #43199, #43200, #42354, #43201). Streaming sessions now start only on UnifiedRadixCache; pure-SWA, FlexKV and plugin tree caches fail at startup with a "not verified" error (#42295), and beam search rejects Mamba models with --disable-radix-cache too (#42354)
The tc_piecewise prefill CUDA graph backend is removed. Passing --cuda-graph-backend-prefill tc_piecewise or a tc_compiler setting now raises an error; CUDA keeps breakable as the default prefill graph backend, and other platforms default to no prefill graph: #42287
Renamed and retired environment variables. SGLANG_AITER_MLA_DCP_DECODE_BACKEND becomes SGLANG_AITER_MLA_DECODE_BACKEND and its default changes from gluon to asm (#34537); SGLANG_OPT_SWA_RELEASE_LEAF_LOCK_AFTER_WINDOW becomes SGLANG_OPT_RELEASE_PREFILL_SWA (#42657); the old names keep working with a deprecation warning. SGLANG_DSPARK_FAST_SAMPLING, SGLANG_DSPARK_FOLDED_SAMPLING and SGLANG_DSPARK_OPT_FUSED_GREEDY_MARKOV are deprecated and no longer do anything (#43622, #43668), and SGLANG_TRITON_PREFILL_TRUNCATION_ALIGN_SIZE is deprecated: #43444
OpenAI chat responses changed in three small ways. tool_choice: "none" no longer shows tool schemas to DeepSeek models (#43006), an absent tool_calls field is omitted instead of returned as null (#43027), and a stream keeps one created timestamp for its whole lifetime: #43026
--enable-layernorm-sp is rejected with pipeline parallelism. It failed on the first prefill before: #43458
For model and plugin authors: ModelRunner.tp_group is removed; read get_parallel().tp_group in the scope the code runs in (#41817). Unread placement attributes such as model.tp_size are gone; read get_parallel() (#41812). A model that declares stage boundaries and runs under pipeline parallelism must pass its shared stage declaration (stage_facts) to make_layers / make_pp_layers: #43460
